# contacts.onManyCreated invalidates contacts and emits an address-book node

The bulk-created observer drops the known address-book contact cache and emits one parent node. Its persistent event wakes the background and converts that node without requesting complete contacts; consumers must rebuild their own cache. The MV3 test directly checks wakeup and address-book payload, not every new card or remote backend. Keep internal onManyContactsCreated and public contacts.onManyCreated distinct.

Scope: extensions-addressbook-events.
